arxiv.abstract: Harsh and rapidly varying orbital illumination introduces failure modes during spacecraft inspection. arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon robotic manipulation fundamentally requires memory: agents must retain task-relevant information from past observations and interactions and use it to guide future actions. arxiv.abstract: When robots are deployed in the real-world, they must interact with other agents and accomplish their own goals while adhering to legal constraints. arxiv.abstract: Propulsive drones are a promising new technology for generating high-resolution terrain models of the Moon. arxiv.abstract: We develop a robust reinforcement learning (RL) framework for learning adaptive treatment policies that generalize across patients and remain reliable under errors in the measured biomarker and shifts in the disease dynamics. arxiv.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based agents and multi-agent systems increasingly tackle complex tasks through long-horizon tool use and inter-agent collaboration. arxiv.abstract: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. arxiv.title: DK-VLM: Geometry as Position for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Vision-language models still struggle to understand 3D spatial relations across views and update spatial judgments as the observer moves. arxiv.abstract: Single image 3D generation aims to dress a given 3D mesh with relightable materials while faithfully preserving the visual details of a reference image. arxiv.abstract: Reconstructing human motion in 4D requires identifying the same surface points through articulation, deformation and changes in visibility. We introduce Dense4D, to our knowledge the first feed-forward model dedicated to dense 4D correspondence across the body, clothing and hair from a set of monocular RGB images, without a body template. arxiv.title: AVC-Reward: Event-Centric Audio-Video Consistency Evaluation
arxiv.abstract: As joint audio-video generation models become more capable, they can generate audio-visual scenes exhibiting three forms of complexity: multi-event composition, multi-layer audio mixture, and asymmetric cross-modal relations. arxiv.title: Not Just a Subject: Capturing Adaptive Scene-Specific Variance for Visual Storytelling
arxiv.abstract: Recent advancements in diffusion models have significantly improved text-to-image generation, enabling their application to visual storytelling, where coherent image sequences are generated from narrative prompts. However, existing methods primarily focus on identity preservation and often fail to adapt to diverse scene variations, resulting in semantic misalignment and structural inflexibility. W

hf_papers.title: VideoJev: System One Model for Video Understanding and Interaction
hf_papers.abstract: VideoJev converts video observations into structured decisions by scoring temporal intervals and text options, enabling efficient reusable inference for visual agents.

hf_papers.title: MJev-Spatial: System One Spatial Intelligence via Native Attention Matching
hf_papers.abstract: MJev-Spatial is a fast multimodal decision model that unifies spatial reasoning tasks into a single-pass classification framework, improving speed and accuracy over autoregressive vision-language models.

hf_papers.title: GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model towards Physical Intelligence with Visual Primitives
hf_papers.abstract: GroundingPI is a 4B grounding foundation model that improves precise object localization and downstream robotic and autonomous driving performance through multimodal pretraining and reinforcement learning.

hf_papers.title: S-Space: Exploring Spatial Workspace in Multimodal Language Models
hf_papers.abstract: Multimodal language models use an intrinsic linear subspace called S-Space to encode object coordinates, supporting spatial perception, reasoning, and response generation, while also revealing bottlenecks in viewpoint transformation.

hf_papers.title: RoTA-Bench: Evaluating 3D Spatial Reasoning through Interactive Projection Alignment
hf_papers.abstract: Vision-language models struggle to convert 2D visual observations into precise 3D rotational control, showing large gaps versus humans in projection alignment tasks.

hf_papers.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
hf_papers.abstract: Reflex is a three-stage framework that enables humanoid robots to catch thrown boxes using egocentric vision by decomposing whole-body control, dynamics inference, and visual perception into sequentially trained stages.

hf_papers.title: 3DCodeVerse: Exploring 3D Worlds as Code
hf_papers.abstract: 3DCodeVerse is a research ecosystem that provides datasets, automated verification harnesses, and empirical guidance to enable scalable, editable, and verifiable 3D content generation via executable code.

hf_papers.title: GreenWAM: A World Foundation Model for Robotics
hf_papers.abstract: GreenWAM is a unified world foundation model for robotics that uses a shared anatomical action space and joint training to serve as both a predictive world model and a control policy across diverse robot bodies.

hf_papers.title: ExeWorldBench: Benchmarking Code-Based Executable 3D World Modeling
hf_papers.abstract: ExeWorldBench evaluates executable world modeling by assessing both structural understanding and code-based 3D construction across mechanism, compositional, and intent-driven tasks.

hf_papers.title: LeWAM: End-to-End World and Action Modeling with JEPAs
hf_papers.abstract: LeWAM is an end-to-end joint-embedding predictive architecture that jointly learns latent dynamics and action flow matching for efficient planning and direct control.

hf_papers.title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
hf_papers.abstract: EmbodiedCLBench evaluates continual learning in embodied agents by testing compositional skill reuse across basic and complex tasks, revealing stable but non-scaling experience benefits.

hf_papers.title: Many Right Answers, One Training Example: Removing Responder Noise from GRPO for LLM Recommenders
hf_papers.abstract: ReMaRk improves reinforcement learning for recommendation by scoring generated lists against all valid replies jointly, reducing training cost while matching or exceeding prior performance.

hf_papers.title: Scoring Higher, Answering Worse: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Rubric-Based RL via Protocol-Level Rubrics
hf_papers.abstract: ProRubric improves rubric-based reinforcement learning by grouping criteria into protocol-level dimensions that require all conditions to hold, preventing compensation and improving answer quality.

hf_papers.title: Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication
hf_papers.abstract: Multics introduces hierarchical group-level communication and dynamic grouping to scale multi-player world models efficiently while reducing interference and maintaining consistency.

hf_papers.title: VLA-Δ: Learning Physical State Transition for Vision-Language-Action Models
hf_papers.abstract: VLA-Δ improves robot control by explicitly supervising physical state transitions between current and future observations, achieving strong benchmark and real-world results without added inference cost.

hf_papers.title: RSI-Anything: Unlocking Recursive Self-Improvement with World Models
hf_papers.abstract: RSI-Anything leverages predictive world models to guide action selection and adaptive learning, enabling recursive self-improvement across coding, interface navigation, laboratory planning, and scientific optimization tasks.

hf_papers.title: WAVE-0: Bridging VLA Policies and WAMs with Lightweight Latent Future Prediction
hf_papers.abstract: WAVE-0 integrates a lightweight latent world model with pretrained vision-language-action policies to guide robotic manipulation via predicted future consequences, achieving high success rates without video pretraining or pixel reconstruction.

hf_papers.title: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
hf_papers.abstract: This survey unifies research on agentic robots by tracing the evolution from robot policies to integrated systems using vision-language-action models, world models, and structured functional domains.

hf_papers.title: Orbia: Do Generated Videos Form a Consistent 3D World?
hf_papers.abstract: Orbia introduces a benchmark that systematically evaluates 3D consistency in interactive video world models through controlled exploration, revisit protocols, and multi-dimensional measurements of input preservation, content persistence, and geometric self-consistency.

hf_papers.title: Can World and Action Modeling Benefit Each Other under Unified Causal Training?
hf_papers.abstract: OneWM unifies causal training of world and action modeling, showing that learning action-conditioned dynamics improves policies and action learning improves multi-view world prediction.

hf_papers.title: WorldCast: Exploring Intelligent Visual Generation in World State Prediction
hf_papers.abstract: Researchers propose a four-level hierarchy for multimodal generative models and introduce the WorldCast benchmark to evaluate multi-step world state prediction, revealing rapid progress by frontier systems but substantial gaps in open-source models for reasoning-heavy visual forecasting.

hf_papers.title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
hf_papers.abstract: SpatialASM trains vision-language models to actively simulate spatial viewpoints and mental reconstructions, improving reasoning across diverse spatial benchmarks.

hf_papers.title: Contextual Correction of Parallel Drafts for Speculative Decoding
hf_papers.abstract: DCOCO restores intra-block token dependencies in diffusion-based speculative decoding by scoring multiple draft candidates in parallel, improving throughput across diverse decoding settings and concurrent loads.

hf_papers.title: HumanoidToolBench: Benchmarking Humanoid Tool Use from Selection to Mobile Execution
hf_papers.abstract: HumanoidToolBench evaluates humanoid robots on tool selection and coordinated manipulation and locomotion across diverse tasks, revealing gaps between selection and execution.

hf_papers.title: Towards Physically Grounded Articulated 3D Assets: A Multi-Agent Pipeline and Benchmark
hf_papers.abstract: Artisan introduces a multi-agent pipeline with physical simulation feedback to generate articulated 3D assets that are physically plausible and functionally usable, supported by a unified benchmark evaluating spatial fidelity, physical plausibility, and downstream performance.

hf_papers.title: WOVEN: Weaving Visual World Modeling into Multimodal LLMs
hf_papers.abstract: Visual transition reasoning serves as a reusable training primitive that improves multimodal reasoning across diverse tasks when supervised by reasoning operation rather than domain.

hf_papers.title: TouchScale: 500 Hours of Human Vision and Touch for Visual-Tactile Learning
hf_papers.abstract: TouchScale is a large-scale, consistently recorded visual-tactile dataset that improves zero-shot contact prediction and robot manipulation performance through scaled pretraining.

hf_papers.title: UNITAS: A 3D-Native World Action Model for Embodied Manipulation

cn_rss.title: Kling 4.0正式上线：10-bit HDR、30秒原生直出 刷新视频模型新基准
cn_rss.summary: 10月15日，可灵AI新一代视频生成模型 Kling 4.0 正式上线。真实、可控、专业，是这一代模型升级的核心方向。Kling 4.0 聚焦高动态、强运镜的视频创作场景，在三个方向实现集中突破：大幅度动态表现更稳定，提升高速运动与复杂运镜的连贯性；单次原生生成最长可达30秒，支持长镜头与连续叙事，导演思维全程在线；全能参考支持最多15项参考素材组合，同时支持最多10张关键帧输入，帮助创作者将一个构思转化为完整作品。与专业创作者建立深度链接，与其共同完成作品创作，尤其是核心镜头的高质量交付，是可灵模型持续迭代的重要方向。专业创作者需要的不只是偶然生成惊艳画面，更要稳定完成决定作品品质的关键镜头
